name: US equity stress
summary: VIX 17.7 and S&P 500 2.4% below its high on 11 Nov, both inside Normal lines after a 3.8% weekly rise
state: The VIX stood at 17.7 on 11 Nov, below the 20 Watch line and down from above 25 on 6 Nov (Yahoo Finance). The S&P 500 was near 7,635, 2.4% below its 52-week high of 7,819 and 3.8% higher over the week, with no session in the past five falling more than 0.4%. Both readings are inside the Normal lines, so US equity stress eases to Normal.
for_you: Pension and investment values linked to US shares have recovered part of their early November fall. Volatility can return quickly while rate-rise expectations and energy prices remain in focus.
rubric_hit: VIX 17.7 < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown 2.4% < 5%: Normal line
why: The S&P 500 is the world's risk barometer; sharp falls and spiking volatility transmit to pensions, credit and confidence globally.
drivers: Earnings, interest-rate expectations, liquidity, geopolitical shocks, positioning and leverage.

rubric.alert: VIX > 30, or drawdown > 15%, or a market-wide circuit breaker trips.
rubric.normal: VIX < 20 and S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high < 5%.
